rulings.text: The one venue is said with «innerhalb der» + genitive between the two published names, in the published order: «Traditioneller Freej innerhalb der Festung der Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa». The inflected adjective «Traditioneller» can only modify «Freej»; the reader's P4 doubt is not a misparse of German syntax, so the order stands.

blind_disposition.disposition: Goal met: one place, the Freej nested inside the fortress.
Out of scope: the published name, kept verbatim; no gloss is added by this batch.

source_defect. Source defect recorded in tr-events-1: the English name «Municipality Fort» does not say what the place is; both names are kept exactly as the published value writes them. Not this batch.
Accepted as is: the fort is the municipality's, as the source says; no change.
Rejected as a syntax fault: the strong masculine ending ties «Traditioneller» to «Freej»; the reader read the relation correctly.
